principle: Biological reproduction, legal/social parentage, guardianship, household and affection are separate systems.
rules: No universal number of biological or social parents is assumed.
Pair/romantic status does not create pregnancy, conception or parentage.
Biological facts and who knows them are separate.
Species-specific reproduction rules must come from authoritative species data; unknown data remains unknown.
Legal adoption, guardianship and inheritance depend on the applicable society/law layer.
Cross-species reproduction is allowed only when authoritative canon/project data supports it.
AI may not infer hidden pregnancy, fertility, parentage or reproductive state from relationship status.
